shared_elements: stylized head with heavy brow ridge and prominent nose
arms held against the body with hands meeting at the front
low-relief surface carving on a monolithic upright form
justification: Both depict a monolithic frontal anthropomorph reduced to a schematic upright body with heavy brow, arms folded low against the torso and hands converging over the abdomen, with nipples marked — a fairly specific shared scheme of an abstracted standing figure. But A's surface is dominated by additional narrative iconography (a row of enclosed animal or head motifs, a banded register with fringe, quadrupeds, a large bird-headed creature and other beasts in relief) that has no counterpart in B, whose figure carries no accompanying creatures or registers and possesses a fully sculpted head with a distinct headdress and no separate zoomorphs.
